question: Prečo sa mnohým ľuďom pri čítaní v aute urobí zle? Oči hlásia mozgu, že stojíte, no iná časť tela cíti každú zákrutu. Ktorá?
source_excerpt: The inner ears and skin receptors sense the car's motion, but the eyes see only the stationary pages of the book.

extra.why_interesting: Almost everyone has felt sick reading in a car, but most assume it is the stomach or 'weak nerves'. The real cause is that two senses contradict each other, and the culprit is a sense organ hidden inside the ear. It suits a car trip perfectly, and the stem gives enough clues to reason it out.
extra.verification_notes: Sensory conflict theory attributes car-reading motion sickness to the eyes seeing a stationary page while the vestibular system (inner ear) senses the car's motion (https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/why-does-reading-in-a-mov).

explanation: Mozog dostáva protichodné správy z očí a z rovnovážneho ústrojenstva vo vnútornom uchu a reaguje na ne nevoľnosťou. Preto pomáha zdvihnúť hlavu a pozerať sa von na cestu pred sebou.

question: Feferónka vytiahnutá z chladničky je studená, a predsa v ústach „páli“. Látka v nej oklame receptory, ktoré inak hlásia skutočné teplo. Ako sa táto látka volá?
source_excerpt: TRPV1 can also be triggered by actual heat, protons, and physical abrasion, so capsaicin produces sensations like warming, tingling, or stinging.

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks eat pickled feferónky straight from the fridge, yet they 'burn'. The player assumes 'hot' is just a figure of speech, but it is a real sensory illusion: a chemical sets off the heat sensor. The name 'kapsaicín' is widely known from food packaging and pepper sprays, so the question is reachable. The milk tip is a practical payoff.
extra.verification_notes: Capsaicin activates the heat-sensing TRPV1 receptor, producing a burning sensation without actual heat (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capsaicin).

explanation: Kapsaicín zapne ten istý receptor ako horúčava, preto sa pri pálivom jedle aj potíme a červenieme. Voda ho nezmyje, lebo sa v nej nerozpúšťa, a preto oveľa lepšie pomôže pohár mlieka.
